## Summary

The feature moves LLM cost computation from always-client-side to being gated by backend type: **client-side only for Databricks**, **server-side for everything else**.

### Changes made (source files only)

1. **`mlflow/version.py`** — `IS_TRACING_SDK_ONLY` already existed and correctly indicates tracing-SDK-only mode. No change needed.

2. **`mlflow/tracing/utils/__init__.py`**

   - Added the `from mlflow.utils.uri import is_databricks_uri` import.

3. **`mlflow/entities/span.py`** — In `LiveSpan.end()`, `set_span_cost_attribute(self)` is now only called when `should_compute_cost_client_side()` returns `True`.

4. **`mlflow/haystack/autolog.py`** and **`mlflow/semantic_kernel/autolog.py`** — Same gating applied to their explicit `set_span_cost_attribute` calls.
